mapper.sql: select id, delivery_no, project_id, order_id, order_no, user_id, user_name, product_title, quantity, total_amount, recipient_name, recipient_phone, recipient_address, tracking_number, delivery_status, delivery_time, sender_user_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from sd_presale_delivery
mapper.select: where order_no = #{orderNo} order by create_time desc

select d.id, d.delivery_no, d.project_id, p.title as project_title, d.order_id, d.order_no, d.user_id, d.user_name, d.product_title, d.quantity, d.total_amount, d.recipient_name, d.recipient_phone, d.recipient_address, d.tracking_number, d.delivery_status, case d.delivery_status when 1 then '待发货' when 2 then '已发货' else '未知状态' end as delivery_status_text, d.delivery_time, d.sender_user_id, d.create_time, d.update_time from sd_presale_delivery d left join sd_presale_project p on d.project_id = p.id where d.project_id = #{projectId} order by d.create_time desc

select d.id, d.delivery_no, d.project_id, p.title as project_title, d.order_id, d.order_no, d.user_id, d.user_name, d.product_title, d.quantity, d.total_amount, d.recipient_name, d.recipient_phone, d.recipient_address, d.tracking_number, d.delivery_status, case d.delivery_status when 1 then '待发货' when 2 then '已发货' else '未知状态' end as delivery_status_text, d.delivery_time, d.sender_user_id, d.create_time, d.update_time from sd_presale_delivery d left join sd_presale_project p on d.project_id = p.id where d.user_id = #{userId} order by d.create_time desc

select d.id, d.delivery_no, d.project_id, p.title as project_title, d.order_id, d.order_no, d.user_id, d.user_name, d.product_title, d.quantity, d.total_amount, d.recipient_name, d.recipient_phone, d.recipient_address, d.tracking_number, d.delivery_status, case d.delivery_status when 1 then '待发货' when 2 then '已发货' else '未知状态' end as delivery_status_text, d.delivery_time, d.sender_user_id, d.create_time, d.update_time from sd_presale_delivery d left join sd_presale_project p on d.project_id = p.id where d.sender_user_id = #{senderUserId} order by d.create_time desc
select count(1) from sd_presale_delivery where project_id = #{projectId}
select count(1) from sd_presale_delivery where user_id = #{userId}
